_comment: LEVEL 4 (component, frontend): settings page — account info from /auth/me, change-password form, logout. Composes comp-login (useAuth) + comp-http-client. Uses [[ ]] delimiters.
name: comp-settings
description: Settings page: account info (from /auth/me), change-password form, logout. Pairs comp-login + feature-auth.
notes: Usage: <SettingsPage /> (defaults: GET /api/auth/me, POST /api/auth/change-password). TODO: implement the change-password endpoint if the backend doesn't have one (feature-auth has login/refresh/me — a change-password route is a small addition) or pass changePasswordPath=null to hide it. Logout clears the token via comp-login's useAuth.
